newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Silver Grant 1996 net rises 42.3 pct.
newsitem.headline: Silver Grant 1996 net rises 42.3 pct.

text.p: NOTE - Silver Grant engages in property leasing, investment holding and share dealing. The company proposed a bonus issue of two-for-one shares held.

Turnover represents the aggregrate of rental income from leasing of properties, dividend income earned from long-term investments and the gross proceeds received and receivable from the trading of marketable securities during the year.

During the year, the group has redefined the definintion of turnover to include the gross proceeds received and receivable from the trading of marketable securities. The turnover in prior year has been restated accordingly to conform with the current year's presentation.
Net is after an exceptional gain of HK$163.40 million on disposal of listed investments and gain of HK$19.31 million on sale of investment properties.
Total dividend for the year is six H.K. cents vs 20 cents.
